question: Related Questions Q. Currently there is a difference of opinion regarding what is known as ?Islamic Banking.? There are some ulama that are of the opinion that this type of banking and the services that they provide are halaal and a practicing Muslim should have not fear and fully take advantage of the variety of services being offered by these same banks. On the other hand there are a group of scholars that aver that this type of banking is no different than regular commercial non Islamic banks. The only differences being in the terminology, but the actual transactions fall into the category of riba. Our question to the ulama ikram is: in the opinion of your darul iftaa, which group is correct, as both can not be correct in this case. Please explain your fatwa completely which will eliminate the doubts in the minds of the common people. 2588 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 32548 Country: India Title: If I happen to find something (e.g.mobile/purse/watch) in a public place and there is nothing mentioned about the owner on thing so found Question: If I happen to find something (e.g.mobile/purse/watch) in a public place and there is nothing mentioned about the owner on thing so found (as in case of a watch), what should i do with it? In case if I have already taken it what should I do now? Answer ID: 32548 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1010/1010/M=1432) In the term of Shariah, such thing is called 'luqta'. It is a trust with you. Having it in your possession, keep on announcing and propagating about it on different places and search for its owner as much as possible. When you are hopeless that you will not get its owner then give it is charity to any poor on behalf of its owner. وعرف اى نادى عليها حيث وجدها وفي المجامع إلى أن علم أن صاحبها لا يطلبها .... فينتفع الرافع بها لو فقيراً وإلا تصدق بها على فقير الخ (شامى زكريا 6/435) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
